models.name: OpenTimelineViewRequest
models.description: Request for opening an observable conversation timeline view.

fields.name: conversationId
fields.description: Conversation id to observe.

fields.name: messageLimit
fields.description: Page size: rows in the initial window and in each older or newer page when a paging request does not give its own (core default 40, at most 100).

fields.name: anchor
fields.description: Open around this message instead of at the latest messages; the window holds half a page on each side of it.

models.name: TimelineAnchor
models.description: The message a timeline view opens around (a search result, a quote, a pinned message).

fields.name: messageId
fields.description: Server id or client id of the target. Its local seq is used when the message is stored locally.

fields.name: seq
fields.description: Conversation seq of the target, used when the message is not stored locally. With neither the open fails with sdk.view.anchor_not_found.

models.name: OpenConversationListViewRequest
models.description: Request for opening an observable conversation list view.

fields.name: conversationLimit
fields.description: Maximum conversations to include in the initial snapshot.

models.name: LoadOlderTimelineViewRequest
models.description: Request for extending an open timeline view with older messages.

fields.name: viewId
fields.description: Timeline view id returned from openTimeline.

fields.name: messageLimit
fields.description: Maximum older messages to load in this page.

models.name: LoadNewerTimelineViewRequest
models.description: Request for extending a timeline view that is not attached to the latest with newer messages.

fields.name: viewId
fields.description: Timeline view id returned from openTimeline.

fields.name: messageLimit
fields.description: Maximum newer messages to load in this page.

models.name: TimelineViewRequest
models.description: Request naming an open timeline view (jumpToLatestTimeline, timelineSnapshot).

fields.name: viewId
fields.description: Timeline view id returned from openTimeline.

models.name: CloseViewRequest
models.description: Request for closing an observable view.

fields.name: viewId
fields.description: View id returned from an open view call.

models.name: TimelineViewSnapshot
models.description: The window of a timeline view: rows in timeline order and where it stands.

fields.name: conversation
fields.description: Conversation header.

fields.name: messages
fields.description: Rows in timeline order (oldest first); pending rows trail when the window is attached to the latest.

fields.name: hasOlder
fields.description: More visible messages exist below the oldest row; answered by the proven seq ranges only.

fields.name: hasNewer
fields.description: More messages exist above the newest row; true exactly when attachedToLatest is false.

fields.name: attachedToLatest
fields.description: The newest row is the latest local message and live messages are appended.

fields.name: anchorKey
fields.description: Row key of the target when the view was opened around a message.

models.name: ViewSnapshot
models.description: Tagged snapshot emitted by core observable views.

fields.name: viewType
fields.description: Snapshot tag: timeline or conversationList.

fields.name: data
fields.description: Snapshot payload selected by viewType: TimelineViewSnapshot for timeline, HomeTimelineSnapshot for conversationList.

models.name: ViewOpenResponse
models.description: Response returned when opening an observable view and by timelineSnapshot.

fields.name: viewId
fields.description: View id.

fields.name: revision
fields.description: Revision of this snapshot; every later view.updated event for the view carries the next revision.

fields.name: snapshot
fields.description: Snapshot of the view at that revision.

models.name: ViewDeltaOp
models.description: One operation in a conversation-list view delta.

fields.name: op
fields.description: Delta operation: insert, update, remove, or move.

fields.name: key
fields.description: Stable item key owned by core.

fields.name: index
fields.description: Target index after applying the operation.

fields.name: fromIndex
fields.description: Previous index for move operations.

fields.name: item
fields.description: Inserted or updated item payload.

models.name: ViewDelta
models.description: Typed delta emitted by core observable views. A timeline delta works by row key (clientMsgId, else serverId, else seq:<conversationId>:<conversationSeq>): remove the keys in remove, replace the rows in upsert in place, put prepend first and append last, reorder by every key when reorder is present, then take the three state fields and conversation. A conversation-list delta is the indexed ops list.

fields.name: viewType
fields.description: Delta tag: timeline or conversationList.

fields.name: prepend
fields.description: Timeline: older rows to put before the first row, in timeline order.

fields.name: append
fields.description: Timeline: newer rows to put after the last row, in timeline order.

fields.name: upsert
fields.description: Timeline: new content of rows already in the window, replaced in place by row key.

fields.name: remove
fields.description: Timeline: row keys leaving the window.

fields.name: reorder
fields.description: Timeline: every row key in the new order; only when the order changed in a way the other steps cannot express.

fields.name: hasOlder
fields.description: Timeline: whether more visible messages exist below the window.

fields.name: hasNewer
fields.description: Timeline: whether more messages exist above the window.

fields.name: attachedToLatest
fields.description: Timeline: whether the window is attached to the latest.

fields.name: conversation
fields.description: Timeline: the conversation header, only when it changed.

fields.name: ops
fields.description: Conversation list: ordered indexed operations.

fields.name: totalUnread
fields.description: Conversation list: latest total unread value.

fields.name: syncState
fields.description: Conversation list: latest sync state.

models.name: ViewUpdate
models.description: Observable view update event payload (view.updated). Every update a view publishes carries the next revision; a host that sees a revision that is not its applied revision plus 1 drops it when it is not newer, otherwise replaces its window with timelineSnapshot.

fields.name: viewId
fields.description: Updated view id.

fields.name: revision
fields.description: Revision this update brings the view to.

fields.name: kind
fields.description: Update kind: snapshot or delta.

fields.name: snapshot
fields.description: Whole view when kind is snapshot.

fields.name: delta
fields.description: View delta when kind is delta.

models.name: TimelineViewPageResponse
models.description: Response of loadOlderTimeline, loadNewerTimeline and jumpToLatestTimeline. The rows themselves arrive only through view.updated.

fields.name: viewId
fields.description: Timeline view id.

fields.name: loadedCount
fields.description: Rows this call added to the window.

fields.name: revision
fields.description: Revision that contains this page (0 when the view was already closed).

models.name: CloseViewResponse
models.description: Response returned when closing an observable view.

fields.name: closed
fields.description: Whether a view registration was closed.
